tools.name: search_roles
tools.description: Search open tech roles in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and remote roles open to people there, newest first. Words match the title, company, place, stack and level, with common other names (frontend finds front end, flutter finds mobile roles). Leave filters out rather than guess them. For one compan

tools.name: get_role
tools.description: One role's full description, places, level, pay, and apply link, by its id from search_roles.

tools.name: company_roles
tools.description: One company's open tech roles on Techny and its profile: sector, headquarters, stage and funding rounds with their sources. Says so when it has no open roles. Use it alone for a company: no search_roles call is needed after it.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Set up free alerts on Telegram for new roles matching a search: give it the same filters as search_roles. It returns a link; the person taps it and presses Start in Telegram, and nothing is sent until they do. For email alerts, give them email_page instead: they enter their address there themselves.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_alert · Public sink: create_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_alert · Public sink: create_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
